violation_type.title: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns (26 TAC §746.3301(b))
violation_type.short_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation is serving a variety of snacks to children that do not have any nutritional value, and that exceed the allowed amount of sugar per the food program guidelines.

finding_variants.text: The operation is serving a variety of snacks to children that do not have any nutritional value, and that exceed the allowed amount of sugar per the food program guidelines.
The center is serving only one snack component to the children for each snack time rather than two snack components from different food groups.
The menu had a few days where only one component is served, and there are grain based desserts are being served.
During snack time children were only served food from one food group which did not meet the USDA nutritional guidelines.
During the inspection, children were observed being served fried chicken with no vegetables for lunch.
A portion of fruit or vegetable was not served during breakfast.     Note: All required food components were served during lunch.
